question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘A Fine Balance’?
solution:
The correct answer is __Rohinton Mistry.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• **Rohinton Mistry** is the author of the book** ‘A Fine Balance’.**
 
• " A fine balance" novel was published in the year 1995.
 
• It was one of the only two books selected for Oprah's book club.
 
• The book belongs to the Genre of " Historical novel". 
 
• ​His other novels include -
 
 
• Such a long journey
 
• Family matters
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Shashi Tharoor books: **An Era of Darkness, Why I Am a Hindu, The Great Indian Novel, Inglorious Empire, The Paradoxical Prime Minister.
 
• **Jhumpa Lahiri books: **The Namesake, The Lowland, Whereabouts, The Clothing of Books.
 
• **Arundhati Roy books:** The Algebra of Infinite Justice, The God of Small Things, The Ministry of Utmost Happiness.
